description: This file defines the Popup_Picker class which manages displaying a popup interface for ACL Roles in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for constructing the popup, generating search filters, handling page processing, and rendering the HTML output for the popup window used in role selection features.

classes.name: Popup_Picker
classes.description: A class that handles the rendering and processing of a popup window used to select ACL Roles within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the Popup_Picker class, currently empty.

methods.name: _get_where_clause
methods.description: Generates a SQL WHERE clause based on the 'query' request parameter to filter roles by name.

methods.name: process_page
methods.description: Main method to generate the HTML content for the popup page, including header, search form, list view of roles, and footer.
